customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of my tenancy at Bahnhofstrasse 47, Chur
customer_message.body: Dear Claims Team, I am writing to ask for your help in contesting the termination of my tenancy at Bahnhofstrasse 47 in Chur, a 3.5-room flat that I rent from Familie Gasser, a private landlord. My wife lives in the flat with me, and it is our family home. We have lived there together since the start of the tenancy. The landlord is ending the lease because of unpaid rent. The landlord states that the rent arrears amount to about CHF 7590. I do not accept that this amount is correct as presented, and I want an independent review of what is actually owed before anything else is decided. I would like the insurer to confirm whether our policy covers legal advice and representation in this tenancy dispute, and to appoint a lawyer who can examine the termination and the arrears calculation. Please let me know which documents you need from me. I can provide my rent payment records, bank statements and the lease contract. I am available by phone in the afternoons and would appreciate a reply within the next week, as this matter is time-sensitive. Thank you for your support. Kind regards, Robin Clarke
